newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNLINES NOT IN FOR UP/DOWNGRADE-ANALYSTS.
newsitem.headline: FINNLINES NOT IN FOR UP/DOWNGRADE-ANALYSTS.

text.p: Share analysts said on Friday Finnish cargo shipping company Finnlines Oy's 1996 earnings had been in broadly line with expectations and no major revisions were expected in their largely positive recommendations.
"The earnings were a shade lower than we expected, but there were no surprises," Aktia Bank analyst Ritva Ojala said by telephone.
Finnlines' 1996 profit after financial items was 404 million markka, up from 315 million in 1995. Analysts' median forecast in a Reuters poll had been a 408 million markka profit.
Aktia Bank would maintain its "buy" recommendation for Finnlines, but may revise the 1997 earnings forecast slightly lower, Ojala said
"We expect a slight improvement in 1997 (operating) earnings," Ojala said, adding that Finnlines' own flat 1997 earnings forecast was in line with the company's cautious policy.
Finnlines said 1996 operating profit had been 444 million markka, up from 370 million, and this year, "operating earnings will probably remain at the previous year's level".
"We see higher volumes for Finnlines as transit shipments to Russia are expected to increase and as strong consumer confidence data indicate higher imports," Ojala said.
Opstock analyst Rami Kinnala said Finnlines' earnings had been slightly above his expectations, but this would not lead to any changes in Opstock's "add" recommendation or earnings forecasts.
"Finnlines' dividend was a positive surprise," Kinnala said.
Finnlines proposed a 4.00 markka dividend per share for 1996, up from 3.00 markka.

Merita analyst Tanja Lounevirta also said Finnlines' dividend had exceeded expectations, but the company's slightly lower than expected 1996 earnings might prompt her to revise her 1997 earnings forecast lower.
"I had expected a slightly higher increase in volumes," she said.
Lounevirta declined to give her recommendation for Finnlines.
At 1330/1130 GMT, Finnlines traded at 12800 markka, down 2.00 markka. Volume was a moderately active 98,600 shares.
